title: Living Room
note: Living / family room pack (tools/make_living_assets.py). The size (dimensions_m) comes from the universal _base_dimensions schema.

living_kind.label: Piece
living_kind.note: Which piece this is: sofa, loveseat, armchair, recliner, sectional, ottoman, pouf, accent_chair, floor_lamp, table_lamp, area_rug, plant_pot, coffee_table, end_table, console_table, tv_stand, sideboard, bookshelf, display_cabinet, toy_chest, rocker, piano, tv, wall_mirror, wall_art or wall_clock.

style.label: Style
style.note: Classic (turned legs, rolled arms, mouldings, brass) or modern (clean lines, slim tapered legs, black metal).

color.label: Colour
color.note: The colour of the fabric, leather, rug or wood: burgundy, forest, navy, camel, charcoal, stone, teal, mustard, mahogany, walnut, cherry, oak, birch, white or black. Not the building paint colours.

power_draw_w.label: Power draw (W)
power_draw_w.note: Watts drawn while it runs; 0 for anything that uses no electricity.
